content: #1 On the nLab there are several links to a (nonexistent) page monoid object which are then redirected to monoid, while I think they should be redirected to monoid in a monoidal category, since we are talking about internal monoids. How can this be done systematically?
subject: Monoid objects is redirected to monoid rather than monoid i…

content:
#2 Thanks for the alert. Now I remember that I ran into this before, but forgot to fix it. Have fixed it now.

How can this be done systematically?

I just removed the redirect lines

  [[!redirects monoid object]]
  [[!redirects monoid objects]]
  [[!redirects internal monoid]]
  [[!redirects internal monoids]]

  [[!redirects algebra object]]
  [[!redirects algebra objects]]

from the entry monoid and pasted them into monoid in a monoidal category.

(See at the very bottom of any page, if you haven’t see these redirect clauses in action yet.)

Thanks again for the alert.

#5 Thanks! It works now. Just a couple of other things:

  • Most examples of monoids in the page monoid are actually monoid objects, so maybe we should move them to the other page;
  • Also, in many pages, the page monoid is linked, but the page monoid in a monoidal category should be linked instead. This is the case, for example, for the links to monoid appearing in the pages ring and category of monoids.

(This makes me wonder: did the pages monoid and monoid in a monoidal category use to be the same page?)
